newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair, union agree on wage cut.
newsitem.headline: Swissair, union agree on wage cut.

text.p: Swiss national carrier Swissair Schweizerische Luftverkehr AG said management and the works council for its airline ground staff agreed a package consisting of a wage cut and shorter working hours.
The package calls for a three percent salary reduction, coupled with a one hour work time reduction, Swissair said in a statement.
It said the goal of the agreement, which covers some 8,500 workers, was to reduce costs by about five percent, or around 30 million Swiss francs.
Similar agreements are being discussed in other business sectors, Swissair said. It said all such agreements must be approved by workers.
Swissair is working on improving its bottom line by 500 million francs by the end of 1997, including 100 million francs in personnel costs through job cuts.
